cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC World Service 的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Nick Miles, and in the early hours of Wednesday, the 2nd of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是尼克·迈尔斯。现在是9月2日星期三凌晨，以下是我们的主要新闻。

cues.en: Iran says US forces have hit a wedding in the south, killing four people and injuring
cues.zh: 伊朗称，美军袭击了南部的一场婚礼，造成4人死亡，并使

cues.en: dozens more, as the aerial campaign ramps up again following a month-long lull.
cues.zh: 数十人受伤；在持续一个月的平静期后，空袭行动再次升级。

cues.en: Five thousand US servicemen will shortly step on land for the first time in nine months, as their aircraft carrier, the USS Abraham Lincoln, docks in Thailand.
cues.zh: 载有5000名美军人员的航空母舰“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号即将停靠泰国；这些人员将首次在9个月后踏上陆地。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, President Putin accuses Germany of planting evidence to blame Russia for an attempted drone attack last month at Leipzig Airport.
cues.zh: 本期播客还将报道：普京总统指责德国伪造证据，把上月莱比锡机场未遂无人机袭击归咎于俄罗斯。

cues.en: Hey guys, we recommend you get out ASAP. There's a big, great white shark out there.
cues.zh: 各位，我们建议你们尽快离开。有一条巨大的大白鲨在那边。

cues.en: Don't go out.
cues.zh: 不要下水。

cues.en: He's just about to jump out on top of it.
cues.zh: 他正要跳到那条鲨鱼上面。

cues.en: The multi-million-dollar scheme trying to keep Australia's swimmers safe.
cues.zh: 这项耗资数百万美元、旨在保障澳大利亚游泳者安全的计划。

cues.en: Last week, Washington said it would begin a campaign of sanctions against some of Iran's main trading partners.
cues.zh: 上周，华盛顿表示将对伊朗的一些主要贸易伙伴发起制裁行动。

cues.en: It was an attempt to bring Tehran to the negotiating table at a time when there was a lull in the military action between the two sides.
cues.zh: 这是为了在双方军事行动暂歇之际，促使德黑兰回到谈判桌前。

cues.en: Now, just a week later, with the new sanctions still largely at the planning stage, military strikes have restarted and are escalating.
cues.zh: 然而仅仅一周后，新制裁大多仍处于规划阶段，军事打击已经重启并不断升级。

cues.en: On Sunday, there was a US attack on Iranian rocket launchers in the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 星期日，美军袭击了霍尔木兹海峡的伊朗火箭发射装置。

cues.en: It triggered a round of Iranian retaliations at US air bases in Jordan.
cues.zh: 这引发了伊朗对约旦美军空军基地的一轮报复行动。

cues.en: Now the US has carried out a larger wave of strikes at targets along the Gulf coast.
cues.zh: 如今，美军又对海湾沿岸的目标发动了更大规模的打击。

cues.en: The Iranian Red Crescent says one hit a house where a wedding was taking place, killing four people.
cues.zh: 伊朗红新月会称，其中一次袭击击中了一栋正在举行婚礼的房屋，造成4人死亡。

cues.en: In response to that, the US military said it does not target civilians.
cues.zh: 对此，美军表示不会以平民为目标。

cues.en: White House spokesman Kush Desai gave this assessment of the overall military strategy.
cues.zh: 白宫发言人库什·德赛对整体军事战略作出了如下评估。

cues.en: President Trump has made it very clear that Iran should stand down and should not
cues.zh: 特朗普总统已明确表示，伊朗应当停手，不应

cues.en: provoke the United States or retaliate, because it will be met with retaliation of orders of magnitude stronger.
cues.zh: 挑衅美国或进行报复，否则将遭到强大数个数量级的报复。

cues.en: So, when you look at the overall situation here, Iran's navy has been wiped out, its air force has been wiped out, its air defenses have been wiped out.
cues.zh: 所以，纵观整体局势，伊朗的海军、空军和防空系统都已被摧毁。

cues.en: The Iranian economy is in disarray.
cues.zh: 伊朗经济陷入混乱。

cues.en: You've had Iranian political leaders themselves admit that they're dealing with inflation, with supply shortages,
cues.zh: 伊朗政治领导人自己也承认，他们正面临通货膨胀和供应短缺，

cues.en: even with petroleum, which is interesting for a country that has some of the largest oil reserves in the world.
cues.zh: 甚至连石油供应也有问题；对于一个拥有全球最大石油储量之一的国家来说，这很耐人寻味。

cues.en: And so, when you just look at the fact that its industrial base has also been wiped out,
cues.zh: 因此，只要看看伊朗的工业基础也已被摧毁这一事实，

cues.en: Iran's position is just so much weaker, and the United States maintains the upper hand here as it has from the beginning of this conflict.
cues.zh: 就会发现伊朗的处境弱得多；美国自这场冲突开始以来一直占据上风。

cues.en: For more on the latest US attacks, I spoke to our State Department correspondent, Tom Bateman.
cues.zh: 关于美军最新的袭击，我采访了本台国务院事务记者汤姆·贝特曼。

cues.en: There's been several different locations targeted along that southern coastline of Iran in the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡沿伊朗南部海岸有多个不同地点遭到袭击。

cues.en: One of what appears to be the most serious incidents that we've been talking about,
cues.zh: 我们一直在谈论的事件中，有一起看起来尤其严重，

cues.en: where you have local officials and the Red Crescent in Sirik saying that a wedding ceremony was struck by shrapnel.
cues.zh: 当地官员和锡里克的红新月会称，一场婚礼仪式遭到弹片击中。

cues.en: It appears to be the Americans having targeted a telecoms tower.
cues.zh: 看起来是美国人把电信塔作为了目标。

cues.en: Now, what those local officials are saying is that at least four people were killed, including a child,
cues.zh: 当地官员现在说，至少有4人死亡，其中包括一名儿童，

cues.en: and up to 50 people wounded from that.
cues.zh: 另有多达50人因此受伤。

cues.en: Now, we put those reports to the White House and the Pentagon.
cues.zh: 我们已就这些报道向白宫和五角大楼求证。

cues.en: We've had no official word from them, although one military official is saying that they are aware of the reports which originated from Iranian state media
cues.zh: 他们没有作出官方回应，不过一名军方官员表示，他们知道这些源自伊朗官方媒体的报道，

cues.en: and says the US military never targets civilians.
cues.zh: 并称美军从不以平民为目标。

cues.en: It may be part of the reason why we had very belligerent language from the Iranians, saying that they were going to respond forcefully to these American strikes.
cues.zh: 这或许是伊朗人措辞非常强硬的部分原因；他们表示将对美国的这些袭击作出强力回应。

cues.en: And that was then followed by what appears to be missile fire from Iran once again over towards Jordan, where there are US military bases.
cues.zh: 随后，伊朗似乎再次向约旦方向发射导弹；那里有美军基地。

cues.en: It seems that a pattern is emerging.
cues.zh: 看来，一种模式正在形成。

cues.en: The US strikes; it warns Iran not to.
cues.zh: 美国发动袭击，并警告伊朗不要这样做。

cues.en: Tehran ignores that, carries out strikes, et cetera, et cetera.
cues.zh: 德黑兰对此置之不理，继续发动袭击，如此反复。

cues.en: This is a strategy that perhaps is not working for Donald Trump.
cues.zh: 这项战略或许对唐纳德·特朗普不起作用。

cues.en: It's not working either in a military sense or in a political and strategic sense.
cues.zh: 无论从军事角度，还是从政治和战略角度看，它都没有奏效。

cues.en: Because remember, six months ago this all began with the stated intention by Mr
cues.zh: 因为要记住，六个月前这一切开始时，特朗普先生的既定意图是——

cues.en: Trump: that he would destroy and prevent Iran ever developing a nuclear program.
cues.zh: 摧毁并阻止伊朗发展核计划。

cues.en: But the problem that Mr Trump has is that the Iranians still have enough fighting power to create enough of a problem for—
cues.zh: 但特朗普面对的问题是，伊朗人仍有足够的战斗力，足以制造足够大的麻烦——

cues.en: the Americans, that they have not been able either to achieve that wider objective about the nuclear program
cues.zh: 让美国人无法实现有关核计划的更广泛目标。

cues.en: nor a problem they didn't have at the start, which is control of the Strait of Hormuz.
cues.zh: 也未能解决他们一开始并不存在的问题——控制霍尔木兹海峡。

cues.en: And the calculation on the Iranian side is they clearly believe
cues.zh: 伊朗方面的判断是，他们显然相信

cues.en: that the Americans won't have the staying power because of how stretched the American military has become,
cues.zh: 美国人没有持久作战的能力，因为美军已经捉襟见肘。

cues.en: and in their view, it is enough to keep, you know, using these insurgency tactics against ships, firing the odd drone or rocket, threatening shipping,
cues.zh: 在他们看来，只要继续对船只采取这种袭扰战术，偶尔发射无人机或火箭弹、威胁航运，就足够了。

cues.en: and that then, you know, by trying to prevent that, the Americans are bombing the Iranians,
cues.zh: 而美国人试图阻止这些行动时，就会轰炸伊朗人；

cues.en: and that then leads to these cycles of escalation, which are now seeing fatalities.
cues.zh: 这又导致不断升级的循环，如今已经造成人员死亡。

cues.en: So, you know, trying to contain this has proved almost impossible for Mr. Trump.
cues.zh: 所以，特朗普先生几乎不可能遏制住这种局面。

cues.en: You mentioned there, Tom, how stretched the US military is, particularly the navy. Tell us a little bit more about that.
cues.zh: 你刚才提到美军，尤其是海军，已经捉襟见肘。汤姆，请再详细说说。

cues.en: Well, I mean, it's become clear over the course of the last few months
cues.zh: 嗯，过去几个月里已经很清楚，

cues.en: that the pressure that the war itself put on American munitions was great
cues.zh: 战争本身给美国军火储备带来的压力非常大，

cues.en: and that it has drained a significant number of very valuable munitions,
cues.zh: 消耗了大量极其宝贵的弹药，

cues.en: things like Tomahawk missiles, things like Patriot air defense missiles,
cues.zh: 包括战斧导弹和爱国者防空导弹，

cues.en: to the extent that America has had to draw on stockpiles elsewhere in the world.
cues.zh: 以至于美国不得不动用世界其他地区的库存。

cues.en: Now, the problem with that is that you have other parts of the US military, according to some recent reporting over the weekend,
cues.zh: 问题在于，据周末的一些最新报道，美军的其他部门

cues.en: who have become concerned about the vulnerability that it creates in terms of America's ability to project its forces globally.
cues.zh: 已经开始担心，这会削弱美国向全球投射兵力的能力，使其暴露在风险之中。

cues.en: And of course, the more the Iranians sense that that is an issue for the US military, the more leverage
cues.zh: 当然，伊朗人越是察觉这对美军构成问题，他们就越觉得自己拥有筹码，

cues.en: they feel it gives them to keep this military element of the campaign going, because they also know about America's electoral timetable
cues.zh: 可以继续推动这场行动的军事层面，因为他们也知道美国的选举日程，

cues.en: that Mr. Trump and the Republican Party have midterm elections coming up, where, according to some of the polling,
cues.zh: 特朗普先生和共和党即将迎来中期选举，而一些民调显示，

cues.en: they could fare very, very badly because of the effect this is having on the price of petrol, the price of gasoline in America.
cues.zh: 这场战争推高了美国汽油价格，可能让他们的表现非常糟糕。

cues.en: That was Tom Bateman. Well, after nine months at sea, the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln has arrived at the port of Pattaya in Thailand.
cues.zh: 以上是汤姆·贝特曼的报道。海上航行九个月后，‘亚伯拉罕·林肯’号航母抵达了泰国芭提雅港。

cues.en: The extended time away from land was mostly spent in the Middle East due to the conflict with Iran.
cues.zh: 由于与伊朗的冲突，他们长期远离陆地，大部分时间都在中东度过。

cues.en: There have been reports of deteriorating mental health conditions amongst the 5,000 servicemen on board and shortages of supplies.
cues.zh: 有报道称，船上5000名军人的心理健康状况恶化，物资也出现短缺。

cues.en: Our Southeast Asia correspondent, Jonathan Head, is in Pattaya.
cues.zh: 我们的东南亚记者乔纳森·赫德正在芭提雅。

cues.en: Once they dock, they're laying on special minibuses for these sailors.
cues.zh: 他们一靠港，就会为这些水兵安排专门的接驳小巴。

cues.en: I mean, they have had a record-breaking 250 days without any port breaks at all.
cues.zh: 他们已经创纪录地连续250天没有任何靠港休整。

cues.en: Everyone knows that conditions on board carriers are stressful, particularly during combat.
cues.zh: 众所周知，航母上的生活压力很大，尤其是在作战期间。

cues.en: They've been involved in combat most of the time in the war against Iran.
cues.zh: 在与伊朗的战争中，他们大部分时间都参与了战斗。

cues.en: So we have had these reports coming out of significantly deteriorating conditions that include mental stress for the crews on board,
cues.zh: 因此，有报道称船员的处境明显恶化，包括船上船员承受心理压力，

cues.en: shortages of supplies, mail not arriving, broken toilets, generally.
cues.zh: 物资短缺、邮件无法送达、厕所损坏，总体状况堪忧。

cues.en: Conditions that the sailors have found even worse than normal.
cues.zh: 水兵们发现，这些状况甚至比平时更糟。

cues.en: Now that's been reported in U.S. military media and by relatives.
cues.zh: 这些情况已经由美国军方媒体和军人亲属披露。

cues.en: The U.S. Navy has insisted that the sailors are adequately supported, but they've acknowledged it's been very, very tough indeed.
cues.zh: 美国海军坚称水兵得到了充分支持，但也承认这段经历确实非常、非常艰难。

cues.en: So, once they dock, and I imagine it might take them a little bit longer to actually get into dock.
cues.zh: 所以，他们靠港后，我想真正驶入港区可能还要花一点时间。

cues.en: Those crew members are badly in need of a break, and of course they've come to Pattaya, a place that's famous for leisure.
cues.zh: 这些船员非常需要休息。当然，他们来到的是以休闲娱乐闻名的芭提雅。

cues.en: I mean, this was pretty much a sleepy fishing village until it was built up
cues.zh: 这里原本几乎只是一个沉寂的渔村，后来逐渐发展起来，

cues.en: by US troops coming during the Vietnam War and using it for rest and recreation.
cues.zh: 越战期间，美军来到这里，把它用作休整和娱乐之地。

cues.en: It's become this incredibly lively, rowdy, large city offering every imaginable kind of entertainment,
cues.zh: 如今它已成为一座极其热闹喧嚣的大城市，提供各种想得到的娱乐，

cues.en: and that's what's in store for these sailors now.
cues.zh: 这正是这些水兵接下来将享受的生活。

cues.en: Jonathan Head. After weeks of indecision, Germany has said Russia was responsible for last month's attempted drone attack at Leipzig Airport.
cues.zh: 乔纳森·赫德报道。经过数周犹豫，德国表示俄罗斯应为上月莱比锡机场未遂无人机袭击负责。

cues.en: The Russian Embassy in Berlin has said the allegation is absurd, and President Putin has accused Germany of planting evidence to blame Russia.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯驻柏林大使馆称这一指控荒谬，普京总统则指责德国栽赃俄罗斯。

cues.en: In the incident, which happened at the beginning of August, a drone carrying an explosive device
cues.zh: 这起事件发生在8月初，一架携带爆炸装置的无人机

cues.en: was discovered at the airport in eastern Germany, close to Ukrainian cargo planes.
cues.zh: 在德国东部的机场被发现，地点靠近乌克兰货运飞机。

cues.en: The German Foreign Minister, Johann Wadephul, said he would order the closure of the Russian consulate in Bonn.
cues.zh: 德国外交部长约翰·瓦德富尔表示，他将下令关闭俄罗斯驻波恩领事馆。

cues.en: The dangerous behaviour of the Russian Federation is part of a long series
cues.zh: 俄罗斯联邦的危险行为是一长串

cues.en: of attempts at destabilisation, threats, sabotage and aggression towards Europe.
cues.zh: 旨在破坏欧洲稳定、进行威胁、破坏和侵略的行为之一。

cues.en: With the attempted attack on Leipzig, the Russian leadership has in fact made a deliberate decision
cues.zh: 俄罗斯领导层企图袭击莱比锡，实际上是蓄意作出决定，

cues.en: to cause further significant damage to our already severely strained bilateral relations.
cues.zh: 要进一步严重损害我们本已极度紧张的双边关系。

cues.en: He also announced tighter entry controls for Russian nationals and vowed to increase pressure on Moscow's shadow fleet,
cues.zh: 他还宣布收紧对俄罗斯公民的入境管控，并承诺加大对莫斯科影子船队的压力，

cues.en: Those are old tankers used by Russia to circumvent Western sanctions following its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
cues.zh: 影子船队由老旧油轮组成，俄罗斯利用它们规避西方制裁；制裁是在俄于2022年全面入侵乌克兰后实施的。

cues.en: President Putin has called the German sanctions against Russia a new era.
cues.zh: 普京总统称德国对俄制裁开启了一个新时代。

cues.en: Arkady Ostrovsky is the Russia and Eastern Europe editor of The Economist.
cues.zh: 阿尔卡季·奥斯特洛夫斯基是《经济学人》的俄罗斯及东欧事务编辑。

cues.en: I think everybody has no illusions about what's going on here, and
cues.zh: 我认为，所有人都清楚这里发生的一切，而且

cues.en: Russia is now targeting military factories and will probably also target logistic hubs that supply Ukraine with weapons.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯现在正把军事工厂作为目标，也很可能打击那些向乌克兰供应武器的后勤枢纽。

cues.en: It's not a surprise really, because the Russians see that Europe is a side in the conflict.
cues.zh: 这其实并不令人意外，因为俄罗斯人认为欧洲是冲突中的一方。

cues.en: It's not an observer. It's not just financing the war.
cues.zh: 欧洲不是旁观者，也不只是资助这场战争。

cues.en: It's actually supplying Ukraine with weapons.
cues.zh: 它实际上是在向乌克兰供应武器。

cues.en: Some of the drones and missiles are made in Europe,
cues.zh: 其中一些无人机和导弹是在欧洲制造的，

cues.en: and if those drones are hitting Russian cities,
cues.zh: 如果这些无人机正在袭击俄罗斯城市，

cues.en: and obviously Germany is not at war and Europe is not at war with Russia, it's a legitimate target.
cues.zh: 而且显然，德国并未与俄罗斯交战，欧洲也没有与俄罗斯交战，所以这就是一个合法目标。

cues.en: I don't think it's a huge surprise, and it kind of shows how meek the German reaction
cues.zh: 我不认为这非常令人意外，这多少说明德国的反应会有多么温和，

cues.en: is going to be, in kind of diplomatic terms.
cues.zh: 至少在外交层面会是如此。

cues.en: Nobody wants an open confrontation, but this exchange, this escalation was expected. Putin is doing it.
cues.zh: 没人想要公开对抗，但这种交锋、这种升级是意料之中的。普京正在推动这一切。

cues.en: I think what's happening is that Putin has been in this situation of kind of a stalemate for months,
cues.zh: 我认为，正在发生的情况是，普京已经处于这种近乎僵局的局面数月，

cues.en: and you could argue for years now on the battlefield, losing tens of thousands of men without actually making much progress.
cues.zh: 在战场上也可以说是多年如此：损失了数万名士兵，却没有取得多少进展。

cues.en: Now, that is not cost-free.
cues.zh: 这当然不是没有代价的。

cues.en: He feels probably it's draining economic and political resources.
cues.zh: 他可能觉得，这正在消耗经济和政治资源。

cues.en: He's losing that kind of silent assent, if you like; the elites are grumbling.
cues.zh: 如果你愿意这样说，他正在失去那种默许，而精英阶层正在发牢骚。

cues.en: And I think he feels that he needs to escalate
cues.zh: 我认为，他觉得自己需要升级行动，

cues.en: because the settlement, the peace deal, he can't accept because, you know, he thinks that would be weak on this term.
cues.zh: 因为他无法接受这项解决方案、这份和平协议；你知道，他认为那样在这一点上会显得软弱。

cues.en: So, I think what we had, the inertia scenario, is just not going to continue.
cues.zh: 所以我认为，我们此前所处的那种惯性局面不会继续下去。

cues.en: I think there is going to be a step-up both in attacks on Ukraine and in attacks in Europe.
cues.zh: 我认为，对乌克兰和欧洲的袭击都会升级。

cues.en: Arkady Ostrovsky there.
cues.zh: 以上是阿卡迪·奥斯特洛夫斯基的评论。

cues.en: In this podcast, we often hear of drones being used in modern warfare for surveillance and, to be frank, killing people.
cues.zh: 在本播客中，我们经常听到无人机被用于现代战争中的监视，说得直白些，就是杀人。

cues.en: But now, a new initiative in Australia is using them to try to save people.
cues.zh: 但现在，澳大利亚的一项新计划正利用无人机努力拯救人们。

cues.en: Stephanie Prentice is following this, and she told me more.
cues.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·普伦蒂斯正在跟进此事，并向我介绍了更多情况。

cues.en: So, Nick, the Australian state of New South Wales, it's been rolling out this $85 million strategy to try and stop shark attacks.
cues.zh: 尼克，澳大利亚的新南威尔士州一直在推行这项耗资8500万澳元、旨在阻止鲨鱼袭击的战略。

cues.en: In its latest plans, it's going to massively expand drone surveillance of beaches.
cues.zh: 按照最新计划，该州将大幅扩大对海滩的无人机监控。

cues.en: They're calling it a dawn-to-dusk operation.
cues.zh: 他们称之为从黎明到黄昏的行动。

cues.en: It's all been triggered by a series of serious shark attacks, including one at Coogee Beach,
cues.zh: 这一切都是一系列严重鲨鱼袭击引发的，其中一起发生在库吉海滩，

cues.en: where someone called Leah Stewart was a regular swimmer following safety precautions, and she fought off a four-metre-long great white shark.
cues.zh: 一位名叫 Leah Stewart 的常规游泳者遵守安全注意事项，并击退了一条四米长的大白鲨。

cues.en: Eventually, people were able to drag her to shore on a surfboard, and she told local media about how she survived, including Channel Nine.
cues.zh: 最终，人们用冲浪板把她拖到岸边；她向当地媒体，包括九号频道，讲述了自己的生还经历。

cues.en: It was huge, and its teeth, its black little beady eyes.
cues.zh: 它非常巨大，还有它的牙齿、黑色的小眼珠。

cues.en: We were looking face to face, and it got to the point where it was about 30 centimetres from my face.
cues.zh: 我们面对面地看着对方，它一度离我的脸只有大约30厘米。

cues.en: Like, I've got to try and punch it.
cues.zh: 我当时想，我得试着打它。

cues.en: And in that moment, I thought, well, which limb am I willing to lose?
cues.zh: 那一刻我想，我愿意失去哪条胳膊？

cues.en: I'm right-handed.
cues.zh: 我是右撇子。

cues.en: So I decided, let's do a left hook.
cues.zh: 所以我决定，来一记左勾拳。

cues.en: So after that left hook, she did lose that arm.
cues.zh: 所以那记左勾拳之后，她确实失去了那条胳膊。

cues.en: And those graphic accounts of what happened, they really fueled this sense of public outrage across New South Wales.
cues.zh: 这些对事发经过的生动描述，确实激起了新南威尔士州各地的公众愤怒。

cues.en: So, if you remember, there was a series of incidents back in January, and we saw four attacks
cues.zh: 如果你还记得，一月份曾发生一连串事故，我们目睹了四起袭击，

cues.en: in 48 hours, including the death of a 12-year-old boy.
cues.zh: 其中包括一名12岁男孩的死亡。

cues.en: It's all led to basically a more strategic approach now from authorities.
cues.zh: 这一切基本上促使当局采取了更具战略性的做法。

cues.en: So, we've got 97 beaches being tightly monitored.
cues.zh: 所以，目前有97处海滩受到严密监控。

cues.en: We've seen drone operators getting to beaches really early as the sun comes up, sweeping the waters before the morning swimmers arrive.
cues.zh: 我们看到无人机操作员在太阳升起时很早就抵达海滩，在晨泳者到来前搜查水域。

cues.en: It's kind of a more advanced version of a community system we've seen online.
cues.zh: 这算是我们在网上看到的社区系统的升级版。

cues.en: The most famous in Australia is called Drone Shark.
cues.zh: 澳大利亚最知名的项目叫作 Drone Shark。

cues.en: In fact, let's quickly listen to that team at work.
cues.zh: 事实上，我们来快速听听那支团队的工作。

cues.en: Massive. Whoa, very good.
cues.zh: 好大。哇，太棒了。

cues.en: Hey guys, we've got a big great white out there.
cues.zh: 大家注意，那里有一条很大的大白鲨。

cues.en: We recommend: get out ASAP.
cues.zh: 我们建议：马上出来。

cues.en: There's a big great white shark out there.
cues.zh: 那里有一条很大的大白鲨。

cues.en: What? Don't go out! No, don't go out!
cues.zh: 什么？别下水！不，别下水！

cues.en: He was just about to jump out on top of it. Oh my goodness!
cues.zh: 他刚要跳到它身上。我的天哪！

cues.en: So, yeah, literally, someone was about to jump on this huge great white shark that was passing by.
cues.zh: 所以，确实，当时有人正要跳到一条路过的巨大大白鲨身上。

cues.en: And they managed to speak to him using a megaphone?
cues.zh: 他们设法用扩音器和他喊话吗？

cues.en: Yes, so they're basically—it's a community service.
cues.zh: 是的，基本上，这是一项社区服务。

cues.en: They're just shouting at people to get out of the water, to get away from sharks.
cues.zh: 他们只是在喊人们离开水里，远离鲨鱼。

cues.en: The new government system and drones, it's more advanced. So these drones can hover over swimmers.
cues.zh: 新的政府系统和无人机更加先进，因此无人机可以悬停在游泳者上方。

cues.en: They can emit alarms, they can give verbal instructions,
cues.zh: 它们可以发出警报，也可以发出口头指令，

cues.en: and we'll also see them on beaches where drones weren't allowed before.
cues.zh: 我们还会在过去不允许无人机的海滩看到它们。

cues.en: And there's also going to be more listening stations around Sydney Harbour,
cues.zh: 此外，悉尼港周边还将增设更多监听站，

cues.en: so they alert people when tagged sharks like great whites, bull sharks, tiger sharks pass by.
cues.zh: 当装有追踪标签的大白鲨、牛鲨或虎鲨经过时，它们就会提醒人们。

cues.en: And the government are also trialling more techy schemes.
cues.zh: 政府还在试验更多高科技方案。

cues.en: So there's an AI component to identify sharks faster.
cues.zh: 其中有人工智能组件，可以更快识别鲨鱼。

cues.en: Eventually, a plan to have autonomous drones.
cues.zh: 最终还计划使用自主无人机。

cues.en: So basically, we're seeing a pretty fast implementation of a multi-layered approach to what seems to be a growing problem for Australia's swimmers and surfers.
cues.zh: 总的来说，我们正在快速实施一种多层面的应对方案，来处理澳大利亚游泳者和冲浪者面临的这一日益严重的问题。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast: in Austria, a law banning headscarves in schools for girls under 14 has come into effect.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后将介绍：奥地利一项禁止14岁以下女孩在学校佩戴头巾的法律已经生效。

cues.en: The headscarf is not just a harmless piece of fabric.
cues.zh: 头巾不只是一块无害的布料。

cues.en: A headscarf worn by a girl, an eight-year-old girl, for instance, is a symbol of oppression.
cues.zh: 比如，一个八岁女孩佩戴的头巾，就是压迫的象征。

cues.en: To Austria now, where a new law that bans girls under the age of 14 from wearing an Islamic headscarf in schools has just come into force.
cues.zh: 现在转到奥地利：一项禁止14岁以下女孩在学校佩戴伊斯兰头巾的新法律刚刚生效。

cues.en: In 2020, a similar headscarf ban for girls under 10 was struck down by the Constitutional Court because it specifically targeted Muslims.
cues.zh: 2020年，一项针对10岁以下女孩的类似头巾禁令被宪法法院推翻，因为它明确针对穆斯林。

cues.en: If a student violates the ban, they must have a series of discussions with school authorities and their legal guardians.
cues.zh: 如果学生违反禁令，必须与校方和法定监护人进行一系列讨论。

cues.en: If there are repeated violations, the child and youth welfare agency must be notified.
cues.zh: 如果屡次违规，必须通知儿童和青少年福利机构。

cues.en: And as a last resort, families or guardians could be fined.
cues.zh: 最后，作为不得已的手段，家庭或监护人可能被罚款。

cues.en: The Austrian government argues that the ban empowers young girls.
cues.zh: 奥地利政府认为，这项禁令赋予年轻女孩力量。

cues.en: Claudia Bauer is Minister for Europe, Integration and Family in the Austrian government. She spoke to Ragini Vaidyanathan about why this ban is being implemented.
cues.zh: 克劳迪娅·鲍尔是奥地利政府欧洲、融合与家庭事务部长。她向拉吉尼·瓦伊迪亚纳坦解释了实施禁令的原因。

cues.en: The headscarf is not just a harmless piece of fabric. A headscarf worn by a girl, an eight-year-old girl, for instance, is a symbol of oppression.
cues.zh: 头巾不只是一块无害的布料。比如，一个八岁女孩佩戴的头巾，就是压迫的象征。

cues.en: Women are veiled wherever extreme Islam is on the rise, and therefore Austria has passed the ban.
cues.zh: 凡是极端伊斯兰势力抬头的地方，女性都会戴面纱，因此奥地利通过了这项禁令。

cues.en: Minister, that is a huge generalisation.
cues.zh: 部长，这是非常严重的以偏概全。

cues.en: There are many young Muslim women around the world who choose to wear the headscarf and are not in any way associated with extremism.
cues.zh: 世界各地有许多选择佩戴头巾的年轻穆斯林女性，她们与极端主义没有任何关系。

cues.en: For us, it is important to protect children, especially young girls.
cues.zh: 对我们来说，保护儿童、尤其是年轻女孩很重要。

cues.en: Schools should be a safe space where values such as equality, individual freedom and also social integration are taught.
cues.zh: 学校应是安全的空间，教授平等、个人自由和社会融合等价值观。

cues.en: Where is your evidence that young girls are being made to wear headscarves?
cues.zh: 有什么证据表明年轻女孩是被迫戴头巾的？

cues.en: I think it is important that schools stay a safe place.
cues.zh: 我认为，学校保持安全很重要。

cues.en: How is wearing a headscarf not safe for a young girl who chooses to wear one?
cues.zh: 一个选择戴头巾的年轻女孩佩戴头巾，怎么会不安全？

cues.en: We talk to a lot of psychologists, for instance, and they see
cues.zh: 比如，我们和很多心理学家交流，他们看到，

cues.en: that when girls begin wearing headscarves in a phase where the body is developing,
cues.zh: 女孩开始戴头巾时，正处于身体发育阶段，

cues.en: the personality is developing at the beginning of puberty, for instance,
cues.zh: 比如正值青春期初期，性格也在发展，

cues.en: then they begin to stand in the second row as well in the classroom.
cues.zh: 她们就会开始在教室里站到第二排。

cues.en: We want to live in a country where girls and men and boys are able to grow up freely.
cues.zh: 我们希望生活在一个女孩、男人和男孩都能自由成长的国家。

cues.en: We want to give them time to decide on their own how they handle the headscarf,
cues.zh: 我们希望给她们时间，让她们自行决定如何处理头巾问题，

cues.en: and they shall decide at the age of religious maturity, which is in Austria at the age of 14.
cues.zh: 她们应在达到宗教成熟年龄时作出决定；在奥地利，这个年龄是14岁。

cues.en: You talk about empowerment and choice.
cues.zh: 你谈到了赋权和选择。

cues.en: A survey that I've seen suggests that 93% of Muslim women actually oppose this legislation.
cues.zh: 我看到的一项调查显示，93%的穆斯林女性实际上反对这项立法。

cues.en: Well, I can understand that, but I think it is important that we stand for European values, for equality. Does
cues.zh: 我能理解，但我认为，坚持欧洲价值观、坚持平等很重要。这是否——

cues.en: Is that a code word for un-Islamic values, though?
cues.zh: 这是不是“不符合伊斯兰价值观”的代称？

cues.en: That's what some would argue, because this is targeting Muslims.
cues.zh: 有人会这样认为，因为这项规定针对的是穆斯林。

cues.en: That's what opponents of this say.
cues.zh: 这正是反对者所说的。

cues.en: No, definitely not.
cues.zh: 不，绝对不是。

cues.en: It is important that we stand for European values,
cues.zh: 重要的是，我们要坚持欧洲价值观，

cues.en: and one of them is the equal treatment of girls and boys, of men and women.
cues.zh: 其中一项就是平等对待女孩和男孩、男性和女性。

cues.en: And I think that starts at a very early age. And I think no eight-year-old girl belongs under a headscarf.
cues.zh: 我认为这应当从很小的年纪开始。我认为八岁女孩不该戴头巾。

cues.en: Critics of the ban argue that it fuels anti-Muslim sentiment and marginalises children.
cues.zh: 禁令的批评者认为，这会助长反穆斯林情绪，使儿童被边缘化。

cues.en: Carla Amina Baghajati supervises and organises Islamic education in public and private schools in Austria. She gave us her reaction to the ban.
cues.zh: 卡拉·阿米娜·巴加哈蒂负责统筹奥地利公立和私立学校的伊斯兰教育。她谈了对这项禁令的看法。

cues.en: As many Muslims in Austria, I feel very concerned, especially as we have seen so many headscarf debates before,
cues.zh: 和许多奥地利穆斯林一样，我感到非常担忧，尤其是我们此前已经经历过这么多关于头巾的争论，

cues.en: and try to be very patient and dialogue-oriented, to clear up as many misunderstandings as possible.
cues.zh: 但我们仍努力保持耐心、以对话为导向，尽可能消除误解。

cues.en: If somebody has a certain view on a religious practice, a negative view, to take this as a kind of explanation and excuse,
cues.zh: 如果有人对某种宗教习俗持有某种看法，甚至是负面看法，就把这种看法当作解释和借口，

cues.en: to say no to it, to forbid it officially, it's not possible.
cues.zh: 借此否定并正式禁止它，这是行不通的。

cues.en: Parents are very concerned and disappointed because they feel patronised rather than empowered.
cues.zh: 家长们非常担忧和失望，因为他们感到自己受到居高临下的对待，而不是得到赋权。

cues.en: If we want empowerment, it can't work by forcing something.
cues.zh: 如果我们想要赋权，就不能靠强迫来实现。

cues.en: We have reports that the children even show signs of feeling not well, anxieties.
cues.zh: 据报道，孩子们甚至出现不适和焦虑的迹象。

cues.en: We have reports of parents who say, 'I try to convince my daughter to put off the headscarf and to tell her,
cues.zh: 据报道，有家长说：“我试着劝女儿摘下头巾，并告诉她：

cues.en: 'Well, don't feel yourself embarrassed and no need for religious worries.'
cues.zh: ‘别觉得难为情，也不必为宗教问题担心。’”

cues.en: It's under force and don't worry,
cues.zh: 这是被迫的，别担心，

cues.en: but nevertheless the children don't want to, and in the end the law punishes the parents.
cues.zh: 但孩子们还是不愿意，最终法律惩罚的是家长。

cues.en: The children feel that their parents are under this pressure, and we have parents who say,
cues.zh: 孩子们感受到父母承受着这种压力，有家长说：

cues.en: 'We want to guarantee a kind of upbringing where there is no pressure and no, I am forced to pressure my child.'
cues.zh: “我们希望确保一种没有压力的养育方式，而不是被迫给孩子施加压力。”

cues.en: That was Carla Amina Baghajati. In the United States,
cues.zh: 以上是卡拉·阿米娜·巴加哈蒂。在美国，

cues.en: jurors in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the woman accused of murdering her three children in 2023, have been sent back to deliberate.
cues.zh: 被控于2023年杀害三个孩子的林赛·克兰西一案中，陪审员已被要求返回继续商议。

cues.en: That's after they told the judge they were deadlocked and unable to come up with a unanimous verdict.
cues.zh: 此前他们告诉法官，陪审团陷入僵局，无法达成一致裁决。

cues.en: Her lawyer argues she was suffering from postpartum psychosis at the time and therefore could not distinguish right from wrong.
cues.zh: 她的律师称，她当时患有产后精神病，因此无法分辨是非。

cues.en: The prosecution argues she made a calculated, intentional decision to kill them. The judge has ordered the jury to keep trying.
cues.zh: 检方称她经过计算、有意作出杀害孩子的决定。法官已命令陪审团继续商议。

cues.en: I brought you back out because I know that this was a long trial.
cues.zh: 我让你们回来，是因为我知道这是一场漫长的审判。

cues.en: All right? I know there were over 80 witnesses, there were over 300 exhibits, but because of that.
cues.zh: 好了吗？我知道有超过80名证人、300多件证物，但正因如此，

cues.en: I'm going to ask you to go back out, keeping in mind all of the instructions that I gave you,
cues.zh: 我要请你们回去，记住我给你们的全部指示，

cues.en: to go out and to continue your deliberations at this time.
cues.zh: 现在继续商议。

cues.en: Jeremy Siegel is a presenter at WGBH News, that's a public broadcaster in Boston. He's been following the case and gave us this update.
cues.zh: 杰里米·西格尔是波士顿公共广播机构WGBH新闻的主持人。他一直在跟进此案，并向我们介绍了最新情况。

cues.en: I think the fact that they haven't been able to come to a decision and told the judge that they're deadlocked
cues.zh: 我认为，他们无法作出决定，并告诉法官陪审团陷入僵局这一事实，

cues.en: is indicative of just how difficult this decision will be for jurors.
cues.zh: 说明陪审员将要作出的决定有多么艰难。

cues.en: They've been hearing testimony for weeks, and as you mentioned,
cues.zh: 他们已经听取了数周证词，正如你所说，

cues.en: the prosecution says that Lindsay Clancy, the mother who's on trial here, should have criminal responsibility for killing her three children.
cues.zh: 检方认为，正在接受审判的母亲林赛·克兰西应对杀害三个孩子承担刑事责任。

cues.en: The interesting feature of this trial here is that neither the prosecution nor the defense say that Clancy did not kill her children.
cues.zh: 这场审判的有趣之处在于，检方和辩方都没有说克兰西没有杀害自己的孩子。

cues.en: They're both in agreement here, but where they differ is on her state of mind at the time of the killing.
cues.zh: 双方对此意见一致，但分歧在于她杀人时的精神状态。

cues.en: So jurors have heard from prosecutors and their witnesses time and time again
cues.zh: 因此，陪审员一再听取检方及其证人的说法，

cues.en: that while Clancy may have suffered from mental illness and been severely depressed in the postpartum state after having her child,
cues.zh: 他们称，克兰西产子后处于产后状态，可能患有精神疾病并严重抑郁，

cues.en: that she was in a clear state of mind where she was able to calculate and commit these murders.
cues.zh: 但当时头脑清醒，能够盘算并实施这些谋杀。

cues.en: Where the defense differs is that they agree that she did kill the children,
cues.zh: 辩方的不同之处在于，他们同样承认她杀害了孩子，

cues.en: but that she was in the throes of postpartum psychosis, which is a rare and somewhat unknown in medical fields diagnosis
cues.zh: 但认为她当时正处于产后精神病发作之中。这是一种罕见、医学界还不太了解的诊断，

cues.en: that is very dangerous and carries a significant risk of both infanticide and suicide.
cues.zh: 非常危险，并带来杀婴和自杀的重大风险。

cues.en: It involves hallucinations, lots of confusion,
cues.zh: 它会导致幻觉和严重的困惑，

cues.en: and it's not a technical diagnosis in the medical books that psychiatrists use,
cues.zh: 而且在精神科医生使用的医学书籍中，它并不是一种技术性诊断，

cues.en: but it's well accepted within the psychiatric community that it is a diagnosis.
cues.zh: 但精神科界普遍认可它是一种诊断。

cues.en: So the prosecution says that she may have been mentally ill, but she wasn't in the throes of psychosis.
cues.zh: 因此，检方称她可能患有精神疾病，但并未处于精神病发作状态。

cues.en: The defense says that she should not be considered criminally liable because she was in the throes of psychosis and is using an insanity defense, as it's called here.
cues.zh: 辩方称，她当时处于精神病发作状态，不应被认定承担刑事责任，并在这里采用所谓的精神失常抗辩。

cues.en: Jeremy Siegel. The American company Tesla was an early world leader in the electric vehicle market,
cues.zh: 杰里米·西格尔。美国公司特斯拉曾是电动汽车市场的早期全球领军者，

cues.en: but the country that's currently making the running in that sector is China.
cues.zh: 但目前在这一领域领先的国家是中国。

cues.en: It's become the world's biggest exporter of EVs, despite being largely shut out of the US market. Nearly a fifth of all EVs sold in Britain are Chinese.
cues.zh: 中国已成为全球最大的电动汽车出口国，尽管基本被排除在美国市场之外。英国售出的电动车中，近五分之一来自中国。

cues.en: So, what's the secret of this success, and why are Chinese electric vehicles so cheap?
cues.zh: 那么，中国电动车成功的秘诀是什么？为什么这么便宜？

cues.en: The BBC's Felicity Hannah has been investigating.
cues.zh: BBC记者费莉西蒂·汉娜对此进行了调查。

cues.en: Here we are. It plays a little tune every time you get in. It's very cheery. Very cheery. It's a little welcome to your car.
cues.zh: 我们到了。每次上车，它都会播放一小段旋律。很欢快，非常欢快。这是汽车对你的小小欢迎。

cues.en: This is Emma, and she's not the only driver who wanted an electric vehicle and opted for a Chinese model.
cues.zh: 这位是艾玛，想买电动车并选择中国车型的司机不止她一人。

cues.en: So, I chose an EV primarily for the sustainability, but also to be honest for the fact that they are just so cheap.
cues.zh: 所以我选择电动车，主要是出于可持续性的考虑，但老实说，也是因为它们实在太便宜了。

cues.en: 18% of electric vehicles, or EVs, sold in the UK are manufactured in China.
cues.zh: 英国售出的电动车中，18%是在中国制造的。

cues.en: In Western Europe, it's also hitting a record high.
cues.zh: 在西欧，这一比例也创下新高。

cues.en: Chinese vehicles are competing on technology, size and availability.
cues.zh: 中国汽车在技术、尺寸和供应方面展开竞争。

cues.en: But perhaps more than anything else, they're competing on price.
cues.zh: 但最重要的竞争因素，或许还是价格。

cues.en: Andy Palmer has been described as the godfather of EVs for his work at Nissan on the Leaf, and he now runs the consultancy Palmer Automotive.
cues.zh: Andy Palmer被称作电动车“教父”，在日产参与Leaf，如今经营Palmer Automotive咨询公司。

cues.en: They've got this advantage in battery technology and they've got this advantage in software technology.
cues.zh: 他们在电池技术上占有优势，在软件技术上也占有优势。

cues.en: The interesting thing is about 91% of the materials that go into batteries are refined in China.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，用于电池的材料约有91%在中国完成精炼。

cues.en: So they really have the supply chain sewn up.
cues.zh: 所以，他们实际上已经牢牢掌控了供应链。

cues.en: It means it's relatively easy to manufacture there as well.
cues.zh: 这也意味着，在那里生产相对容易。

cues.en: If you look at making an EV and you exclude the battery, and let's exclude the fuel tank on an internal combustion engine, just to be fair,
cues.zh: 如果看电动车的制造成本，先不算电池；为公平起见，也不算内燃机汽车的油箱，

cues.en: The cost of manufacturing an EV is lower, except for the battery.
cues.zh: 电动车的制造成本更低——电池除外。

cues.en: The battery technology is key. So they're cheap, they're innovative, but are they ethical?
cues.zh: 电池技术是关键。所以它们便宜、创新，但合乎道德吗？

cues.en: A frequent criticism of Chinese car makers is that quality, innovation and price competitiveness have only been possible because of Beijing's support.
cues.zh: 对中国汽车制造商的一项常见批评是，其质量、创新和价格竞争力之所以能达到如今水平，全靠北京方面的支持。

cues.en: Some argue that China is effectively dumping state-subsidised vehicles in the EU and UK to gain market share, and that these prices would not be sustainable.
cues.zh: 有人认为，中国实际上是在欧盟和英国倾销国家补贴的汽车，以获取市场份额，而这样的价格无法持续。

cues.en: While that is an accusation, however, that has been strongly disputed by the car makers themselves.
cues.zh: 不过，汽车制造商本身强烈反驳了这一指控。

cues.en: Dr Brian Gu is co-president of the Chinese EV maker XPeng.
cues.zh: Brian Gu博士是中国电动车制造商小鹏汽车的联席总裁。

cues.en: I don't think the Chinese government is supporting every player. In fact, there are probably more competitors in China than outside of China.
cues.zh: 我不认为中国政府在支持每一家企业。事实上，中国国内的竞争者可能比中国以外更多。

cues.en: I would say the Chinese company's success is because they came out of the most competitive market.
cues.zh: 我认为，中国企业的成功源于它们来自竞争最激烈的市场。

cues.en: I would say the fittest win, using that analogy, and bring that technology, the efficiency, and the cost competitiveness to markets outside of China.
cues.zh: 借用这个比喻，我会说这是适者胜出的市场；他们把技术、效率和成本竞争力带到了中国以外的市场。

cues.en: So do you think that those accusations that Chinese EV makers are dumping vehicles are genuine concerns from those governments?
cues.zh: 那么，你认为那些政府对中国电动车制造商倾销汽车的指控，确实是它们的担忧吗？

cues.en: We don't agree with the assessment that China is producing excess capacity.
cues.zh: 我们不同意“中国正在制造过剩产能”这一判断。

cues.en: In fact, we don't have enough capacity in China to produce and satisfy our demands.
cues.zh: 事实上，我们在中国的产能甚至不足以满足自身需求。

cues.en: Chinese models are not just disrupting markets, they're also creating demand in new markets.
cues.zh: 中国车型不仅正在冲击现有市场，也在新市场创造需求。

cues.en: Here's Professor Alex Clowes of Euro EV, a European importer and distributor of Chinese electric vehicles.
cues.zh: 下面请听Euro EV的Alex Clowes教授发言；该公司是中国电动车的欧洲进口商和经销商。

cues.en: They have picked up all the markets that the Americans and the Europeans have left.
cues.zh: 他们接手了美国人和欧洲人留下的所有市场。

cues.en: I used to work for Ford.
cues.zh: 我过去曾在福特工作。

cues.en: Ford had a real big plant in Brazil. Now suddenly Ford wasn't that successful, profitability-wise, in Brazil anymore, so they decided to leave.
cues.zh: 福特在巴西曾有一家很大的工厂。后来突然间，从盈利角度看，福特在巴西已不再那么成功，于是决定离开。

cues.en: And what happened?
cues.zh: 后来发生了什么？

cues.en: BYD picked it up, and now BYD is the battery electric vehicle of Brazil.
cues.zh: 比亚迪接手了，如今比亚迪成了巴西的纯电动车代表。

cues.en: We are seeing governments respond to this.
cues.zh: 我们看到各国政府正在对此作出回应。

cues.en: So, for example, there are tariffs on Chinese EVs coming into Europe, which make them seem more expensive.
cues.zh: 比如，欧洲对进口中国电动车征收关税，使它们看起来更昂贵。

cues.en: Do you think that's fair to consumers?
cues.zh: 你认为这对消费者公平吗？

cues.en: The European car industry, I think, shouldn't vanish, but it needs to transform.
cues.zh: 我认为，欧洲汽车产业不该消失，但必须转型。

cues.en: It is unfair, but at times it might be necessary to help an industry over a time of change.
cues.zh: 这并不公平，但有时或许有必要帮助一个产业度过转型期。

cues.en: But what's really important is to make the change happen.
cues.zh: 但真正重要的是推动转型发生。

cues.en: European governments are understandably anxious about their homegrown car makers and their workforces.
cues.zh: 欧洲政府担心本土汽车制造商及其员工，这种担忧可以理解。

cues.en: It's a concern shared by the US, which has levelled tariffs of 100% on Chinese-made vehicles.
cues.zh: 美国也有同样担忧，并已对中国制造的汽车征收100%的关税。

cues.en: The question is whether drivers will share those concerns, or if they simply want to get behind the wheel of a much cheaper car.
cues.zh: 问题在于，司机会不会有同样担忧，还是只想驾驶一辆便宜得多的汽车。

cues.en: Felicity Hannah.
cues.zh: 费莉西蒂·汉娜报道。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是目前的全部内容。

cues.en: If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以发送邮件至globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also find us on X at BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 你也可以在X上通过BBC World Service找到我们。

cues.en: Use the hashtag GlobalNewsPod.
cues.zh: 请使用话题标签GlobalNewsPod。

cues.en: And don't forget our sister podcast, The Global Story, which goes in-depth and beyond the headlines on one big story.
cues.zh: 别忘了我们的姊妹播客《全球故事》，它会围绕一个重大故事深入报道，带你超越新闻标题。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Nikki Brough.
cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由Nikki Brough负责混音。

cues.en: The producer was Alice Adderley.
cues.zh: 制片人是Alice Adderley。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 编辑是Karen Martin。

cues.en: I'm Nick Miles, and until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是Nick Miles，我们下次再见。
